viv: Heads-up — onboarding sample hit a weird SSE edge: mobile web shows garbled emoji + premature close on long streams. Go/node/python SDKs unaffected.
chris: repro steps? which sample?
viv: examples/onboard-stream, LONG_PROMPT=true. Open on iOS Safari and Chrome for Android. ~1/12 runs show UI parse errors or truncated emoji. Logs below.
viv: ```
[2167-11-02T09:10:11.001Z] runtime: emit seq=102 data="{\"text\":\"Hello \\uD83D"\n[2167-11-02T09:10:11.002Z] runtime: keepalive (blank event)
[2167-11-02T09:10:11.003Z] edge: coalesced reads - merged frames
[2167-11-02T09:10:11.004Z] runtime: emit seq=103 data="DE0A\",\"more\":1}"
[2167-11-02T09:10:11.005Z] client/mobile: EventSource.onerror -> close
[2167-11-02T09:10:11.006Z] ui: JSON.parse error at position 13
```
noor: two things colliding: 1) surrogate-split across seq boundary (\uD83D / DE0A) and 2) keepalive + edge coalesce leads onerror to fire before the second half arrives. Mobile browsers appear more eager to treat onerror as fatal.
mike: SDK parity check: Java/Swift mobile SDKs do not exist yet for sample-app; our server-side SDKs use low-level streaming codecs that reassemble bytes, so they avoid the parse failure. Browser sample naively concatenates e.data and parse attempts as soon as any event arrives.
chris: short-term sample fix: add a small streaming helper sseStreamSafe that (a) uses TextDecoder with {stream:true} when available, (b) buffers partial text and only JSON.parse when parse succeeds, (c) debounce keepalives for 80ms so back-to-back empties don't trigger finalization. Also add opt-in onerror grace of 120ms for mobile helper.
noor: I can prototype TextDecoder-based reassembler. Pseudocode: ```js
const dec = new TextDecoder();
let buf = '';
eventSource.onmessage = e => {
  // treat empty as keepalive
  if (!e.data.trim()) return scheduleHeartbeatDebounce();
  // decode and append (handles split UTF-8)
  buf += dec.decode(new TextEncoder().encode(e.data), {stream:true});
  try { const obj = JSON.parse(buf); onobj(obj); buf = ''; } catch(e) { /* wait for more */ }
}
```
viv: careful: new TextEncoder on each msg is wasteful — but main idea is to prefer streaming decode of raw bytes where possible. Also fallback if e.data is already a string.
chris: also add a defensive split on multiple JSON objects inside one message (coalesced frames): scan for `}{` boundaries and attempt to parse multiple objects before buffering remainder.
mike: medium-term runtime change: emit explicit event names for framing: `event: delta` for token chunks, `event: keepalive` for heartbeats, `event: done` for final + resume token. That makes client intent explicit and avoids ambiguity with blank-data semantics and proxy CRLF normalization.
noor: agree. That also helps SDKs; then we can implement SDK parity helpers to parse by `event` rather than empty lines.
mobile-bot: Mobile QA: reproduced on iOS 16.6 Safari and Chrome WebView on Android 13. Behavior: onerror fires faster if system memory low; grace window needed.
ops-bot: INFRA-521 opened to audit edge coalescing and CRLF normalization on abort path. Will add extra logging when keepalive events observed adjacent to client aborts.
chris: tests: add unit that simulates (a) split surrogate pair across two seqs, (b) coalesced frame delivering two JSONs in one event, (c) keepalive then immediate data with proxy-inserted CRLF. Ensure helper handles all.
viv: I pushed a tiny sample-app PR with helper + README notes: PR #5011. CI ran 24/24 local e2e post-fix.
ci-bot: CI: sample-app browser matrix: Chrome 50/50 baseline -> 60/60 on helper branch; Safari iOS improved 56/60 -> 59/60.
mike: SDK parity plan: add sseStreamSafe into JS SDK as shim, then port to Swift/Java to cover mobile. Document tradeoffs: grace window may hide real disconnects; keep it opt-in and only in high-level helpers used by sample-app / onboarding. Core SDKs should expose low-level primitives.
noor: one more nit: Last-Event-ID resends can duplicate fragments. Implement dedupe that is fragment-aware: if resent seq arrives, try to merge overlapping bytes before dropping. We'll add a small reassembly map keyed by resume-token+seq with byte-offset heuristics.
chris: agreed. Add telemetry: metric streaming_reconnect_duplicate_resends and streaming_incomplete_utf_split_count to monitor.
viv: thanks all. I'll coordinate with infra on INFRA-521 and follow up on the runtime RFC for explicit event framing. Landing PR today for sample-app and docs update in onboarding. :rocket:
